interpretation: faithfulness_rate is the share of a tier's summaries that cited only supplied numbers and named no condition. A tier that produced an unfaithful summary was overridden at request time -- the cascade falls through -- so this measures how often that guard fired, not how often a bad summary reached a clinician.
caveat: Faithfulness checking is necessary, not sufficient. It cannot detect a fluent, numerically correct, clinically wrong reading of the data. No claim is made about clinical quality of the text.
